title: LocalAI/home.json
description: The widgets of the Home page, in order.

widgets.description: At most 12 widgets, and at most 3 of type page: each page widget runs its page.

source.title: Data file
source.description: A file in your home that follows widget-data.schema.json, such as data/tasks.json.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: The id of the trigger that rewrites the data file. The widget shows when it runs, its last run, and Pause.

page.title: Page
page.description: For a page widget: the name of a page, the folder pages/<name>/ of your home. Its page.json must have a widget block.

folder.title: Shared folder
folder.description: For a page widget of a shared folder: the folder_id of the shared pages list. Leave it out for a page of your home.
